description: Source code implementing DNS utility functions related to mDNS endpoints and HTTPS query name generation within the Chromium project.

methods.name: GetMdnsIPEndPoint
methods.description: Constructs an IPEndPoint for mDNS multicast group based on an IP address literal.

methods.name: GetMdnsGroupEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the multicast group endpoint for mDNS based on the address family.

methods.name: GetMdnsReceiveEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint to receive mDNS messages, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: GetNameForHttpsQuery
methods.description: Generates a DNS query name for HTTPS based on a URL scheme and host, normalizing schemes and ports.
